# About Page
![About page image](imgs/about_page.png)
The About page provides background information on the development of the PlaViSca web application. It highlights the goals, design principles, and collaborative nature of the project.

PlaViSca is an open-source initiative, and we welcome contributions from the scientific community. Researchers interested in integrating new datasets, improving existing features, or collaborating on future development are encouraged to get in touch.

This section also introduces the development team, including contact details for inquiries and collaboration opportunities.

Additionally, a link to the full source code is provided, allowing users to explore, use, or extend the application.
